items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They had a White policeman named Sweetman -- which was a tough character, too.

ctx.x: Because Blakeney is playing trumpet on that, too; that's Blakeney's first record. So he must have been a local character.

Any musician that lived here in Los Angeles that had two tough cops... Sheffield was a Black policeman, and they had a White policeman named Sweetman -- which was a tough character, too. They caught you in one of them joints, they'd put you in jail. But what Sheffield would do, now... They claimed Sheffield was bad. He was bad on people that he didn't know. But he never hardly bothered musicians unless he caught you drunk, and you got a little smart or belligerent with him. He usually would let you go. I remember…
